headline: Parade history
lead: The community has put Tết parades on the street. Vietnamese groups have also marched as a unit on someone else’s route — the train Little Saigon Krewe is building. Newest years first.

entries.headline: Little Saigon Krewe’s first train — Golden Harvest
entries.body: Groups checked in on 10th St and marched Capitol Mall as one krewe train — Duc Huong Sandwiches as presenting sponsor, Lạc Hồng language school, VACOS, and partner orgs walking together. Not the host: a unit on someone else’s route.

entries.headline: Mardi Gras twist at the park
entries.body: 2026 added a Mardi Gras twist — that is where the krewe idea landed. Enjoy Life taped the park parade, not Stockton Blvd.

entries.headline: A thicker Vietnamese line on Capitol Mall
entries.body: Golden Harvest’s 2025 edition already had Viet Serenity Sisters, pageant, cPALSs, and NVCC on the route — precedent for a krewe train the next year.

entries.headline: Liên Đoàn Lạc Việt on Veterans Day
entries.body: Pack and Troop 243 already know how to be a unit on a civic street: uniforms, US and heritage flags, rows of youth. Their Veterans Day 2025 appearance is that grammar — precedent for a krewe train, not a community-hosted Tết parade.
entries.imageAlt: Liên Đoàn Lạc Việt Pack and Troop 243 in uniform with US and heritage flags on Veterans Day 2025

entries.headline: Civic Tết at Elk Grove Park
entries.body: Civic Tết moves to Elk Grove Park on the Lunar New Year weekend. Nhịp Sống Cali taped the park parade.
entries.youtubeTitle: 2024 Elk Grove Park Tết — Nhịp Sống Cali

entries.headline: Mrs. Vietnam and Xang Xu Liu on Capitol Mall
entries.body: Vietnamese entries kept walking Golden Harvest — Mrs. Vietnam and Xang Xu Liu among the 2024 line.

entries.headline: cPALSs, NVCC, pageant — early Capitol Mall years
entries.body: Golden Harvest Parade & Festival has run on Capitol Mall since 2022. Vietnamese entries already walked it: cPALSs / NVCC and Mrs. Vietnam in the first two editions.

entries.headline: Đinh Dậu Parade
entries.body: The street march landed on Tết Saturday, from the Happy Garden lot along Stockton Blvd into the hội chợ. SN&R also billed a Florin & Stockton Blvd fair Saturday–Sunday, February 4–5 — a later weekend, not this tape.

entries.headline: Little Saigon Tet Parade + Lunar Flower Festival
entries.body: Parade at 9 AM, Stockton Blvd & Fruitridge — the same Saturday as the lot festival. HeuFamilyEnt taped the march; KCRA named both hosts.
entries.youtubeTitle: Little Saigon Lunar Flower Fest 2016 — Parade (HeuFamilyEnt)

entries.headline: Giáp Ngọ Parade
entries.body: VACOS hosted parade and hội chợ at NE Florin & Stockton Blvd (rain-moved). SBTN taped both the march and the lot.
entries.youtubeTitle: Diễn hành và Hội Chợ Tết Giáp Ngọ 2014 (SBTN)

entries.headline: Xuân Quý Tỵ Parade
entries.body: A corridor parade and hội chợ on Stockton Blvd / Florin after the branded weekend. HyRo taped the street parade that Saturday.

entries.headline: Little Saigon Street Festival Parade
entries.body: The corridor filled again — GSVACC, Florin Partnership, and many amateur cameras. Rain moved the weekend from January 21 to this Saturday. LITTLE SAIGON TV taped it; it remains the best-recorded Little Saigon Tết parade we have.

entries.headline: Little Saigon designation — and a New Year parade
entries.body: City and County ribbon cuttings, and a Tết parade down Stockton Blvd toward Florin. Neighbors filled the corridor that designation weekend — we marched in Little Saigon.

entries.headline: Vietnamese units on the city Veterans Day route
entries.body: Hội cựu tù nhân, Thủ Đức, quân cảnh, thanh thiếu niên quân đội, and thiếu sinh quân marched with about a hundred other units. Not a Tết host year — a civic parade, Vietnamese blocks in the line.
